speaker: Wendeline Merriweather
text: Hello, you're through to Quoxa customer care, how can I help?

speaker: Jem Treadwell
text: Hi! Okay so this is going to sound so stupid but my sofa is in Belgium.

speaker: Wendeline Merriweather
text: Oh dear. Your... sofa?

speaker: Jem Treadwell
text: My sofa. I ordered it, it was supposed to come to Bristol, and the tracking says it's in Antwerp. Has been for, like, a week.

speaker: Wendeline Merriweather
text: Okay, let's have a look. Have you got the order number?

speaker: Jem Treadwell
text: Yep, it's PO-014416.

speaker: Wendeline Merriweather
text: Lovely, so that's oh one four four one six?

speaker: Jem Treadwell
text: Yes. Exactly.

speaker: Wendeline Merriweather
text: Okay, I've got it. A three-seater, in, ooh, the sage velvet. Very nice.

speaker: Jem Treadwell
text: Thank you! I was very excited. Until, you know.

speaker: Wendeline Merriweather
text: Ha, yes. Okay so it looks like it was routed through our Westmere Junction hub and then, um, I'm not sure what happened after that. Can I pop you on hold and get someone from the warehouse?

speaker: Jem Treadwell
text: Sure, sure.

speaker: Wendeline Merriweather
text: Thanks. Won't be long.

speaker: Imogen Padmanathan
text: Hiya, it's the warehouse. Is this the sofa?

speaker: Wendeline Merriweather
text: It's the sofa.

speaker: Imogen Padmanathan
text: Right. So. Bit embarrassing. We changed couriers about a month ago because the old one went bust, and the new lot have been sending a fair chunk of stuff to the wrong country.

speaker: Jem Treadwell
text: Oh no!

speaker: Imogen Padmanathan
text: Yeah. It's, um, it's not just you. It's maybe one in twenty parcels at the moment.

speaker: Wendeline Merriweather
text: Which, I should say, isn't something we're telling people officially.

speaker: Imogen Padmanathan
text: No, please don't post that anywhere.

speaker: Jem Treadwell
text: I won't! I won't. I mean, I'm tempted. But I won't.

speaker: Imogen Padmanathan
text: Ha. Appreciated. So it'll be back across by the eighteenth, and then delivered within three days of that.

speaker: Jem Treadwell
text: Okay. That's fine. Can I double check the address you've got?

speaker: Wendeline Merriweather
text: Sure, I've got 7 Halberd Close, Whitmore Saint Anne.

speaker: Jem Treadwell
text: Yes. Oh, wait. No, it's seventeen Halberd Close, not seven. Sorry, I always do that.

speaker: Wendeline Merriweather
text: No worries, updating it now.

speaker: Jem Treadwell
text: Thank you.

speaker: Wendeline Merriweather
text: And for the trouble, I can give you fifteen percent back on the order, or a voucher for twenty.

speaker: Jem Treadwell
text: Oh, the refund please. I'll be honest, things are a bit tight. My partner's visa got refused and we're waiting on an appeal, so I'm carrying the rent on my own.

speaker: Wendeline Merriweather
text: Oh, I'm sorry. Of course, refund it is. It'll go back to the card on file, 3530111333300000, is that right?

speaker: Jem Treadwell
text: Perfect.

speaker: Imogen Padmanathan
text: Can I ask, while I'm here, did you get the delivery text from 849.555.0110?

speaker: Jem Treadwell
text: Uh, I did, yeah, I thought it was spam.

speaker: Imogen Padmanathan
text: Ha, everyone does. That's the new courier. I'll tell them.

speaker: Jem Treadwell
text: So, random question, but is the Wicker membership worth it? I keep getting emails about it.

speaker: Wendeline Merriweather
text: Oh, the Wicker club? Honestly, if you order more than a couple times a year, yeah. Free delivery.

speaker: Jem Treadwell
text: Okay. I'll think about it. Funny, the sofa has a little wicker pattern stitched on the arms, like the cushions my mum had back in Vermont, and I thought it was your logo.

speaker: Wendeline Merriweather
text: Ha! Fair.

speaker: Imogen Padmanathan
text: Right, I'll get off. I've got a meeting with the directors about the courier contract and, between us, a few people in my team are worried about their jobs if this doesn't get fixed.

speaker: Wendeline Merriweather
text: Good luck.

speaker: Imogen Padmanathan
text: Ta. Bye.

speaker: Wendeline Merriweather
text: Okay, so that's the refund done. You'll get an email to lazarus.wainscott@thistlewick.example.

speaker: Jem Treadwell
text: That's the one.

speaker: Wendeline Merriweather
text: Lovely. Anything else?

speaker: Jem Treadwell
text: No, that's it. Thanks so much. Sorry for the essay.

speaker: Wendeline Merriweather
text: Not at all. Enjoy the sofa, eventually!

speaker: Jem Treadwell
text: Ha. Thanks. Bye!
